name: PreVibe
description:
PreVibe turns a raw product idea into a market research report you can act on.

Describe your idea in plain language. PreVibe runs live web research and returns
a verdict badge, a score, a short summary, the key findings, and the three
strongest bets - the angles most likely to work, and why now. Key figures come
with clickable sources, or are marked honestly when no source exists. You also
get the main reasons the idea could fail, and what would change the answer.

From a finished report you can go further:

- Deep dives expand the idea, or any top bet, into positioning, MVP scope, and a
  go-to-market angle.
- Brand names generate name ideas grounded in your research, then check domain
  availability through a registrar.

The connector's tools cover the whole workflow. Some only read data you already
own: list and fetch researches, deep dives, and brand-name runs, and check your
credit balance. Others create, retry, or delete. Every tool declares what it
does through standard MCP annotations, so you can see which ones only read and
which ones change something before you approve.

Who it is for: solo founders and small teams who want evidence before committing
weeks of build time.

Before you connect: a free PreVibe account, created with Google sign-in. New
accounts include a free credit to start. Generating a research, a deep dive, or
a brand-name run costs 1 credit each. Everything else - listing, fetching,
retrying, deleting, checking domains, checking credits - is free.

Your ideas stay yours. We configure our AI providers for zero data retention
where that option is available.

_published_faq.name: How do I add PreVibe to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add PreVibe to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://previbe.io/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the PreVibe MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: PreVibe lists 17 MCP tools, including check_brand_names_domain_availability, check_credits, create_brand_names, create_deep_dive, create_research, delete_brand_names, delete_deep_dive, delete_research, get_brand_names, get_deep_dive, get_research, and list_brand_names.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to PreVibe?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to PreVibe in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
PreVibe requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
PreVibe is developed by Kometo Labs LLC. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
